primer: Tanfac Industries has executed a real operational upgrade under Anupam Rasayan and TIDCO. The company doubled AHF capacity, launched India's sole Solar-Grade DHF line with a ₹732 Cr Kredence contract, and raised ₹349.41 Cr equity for HFC-32. However, Q2 FY27 OPM fell to 11.84%, FY26 CFO/EBITDA lagged at 56%, and 99.32x TTM P/E yields a -10.1% expected return. New capital is REJECTED, and the 70-share Zerodha holding is flagged for immediate exit into 100% cash.
